races.paceDynamic: Mont St Michel is the sole confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead at a comfortable gallop over this stamina-testing trip on soft ground. With most rivals adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, he'll face minimal early pressure and can dictate terms throughout the maiden hurdle. The lack of pace pressure means the race will likely develop into a staying test from the back of the last hurdle, where stamina and tactical positioning become crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with a strong finish, as they can capitalize on any faltering by Mont St Michel in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Mont St Michel maintains his gallop and the lack of early pace doesn't expose stamina limitations
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run approaching the final flight while others are still making ground, and his advantage proves decisive. Front runners and prominent trackers who stayed close benefit most from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick From Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows prominent runners to conserve energy and unleash a sustained drive
scenarios.body: Horses like Colcannon and Newbrook Diamond can track Mont St Michel comfortably before quickening past him late. Their tactical positioning and class edges prove telling in a stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace and soft ground create perfect conditions for a late charge from the rear
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows hold-up horses to close strongly, with one timing their run to perfection. Splendid Fellow or Chopsticks could benefit from the tactical setup and their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and allows a long-priced runner to steal through
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop and large field create opportunities for horses to improve dramatically on previous form. A horse with decent placed form could capitalize on the tactical scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Green Hope, Maverick Mack, Umpire's Call and Frankie's Freebie will create a fierce early gallop with no shortage of pace. The field will string out quickly on soft ground over 2m4f, with prominent runners like Some Song, Doctor Elvis and Sticwiththeprocess caught in traffic problems approaching the business end. The sustained gallop will expose stamina limitations and favour horses that can settle and produce late kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay wide and time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is truly strong and the field strings out significantly
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will compromise prominent runners and create perfect conditions for closers to pick off tired leaders. Horses like Aurea Fortuna and Don Jefe can use their class to sweep past faltering pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactical winner
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner can avoid the early traffic and position perfectly
scenarios.body: A horse like Some Song or Doctor Elvis finds the ideal pitch behind the leaders without getting caught in the squeeze. They can kick clear when the pace collapses and hold off the late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more measured than expected
scenarios.body: Green Hope or Maverick Mack can control the tempo and kick again when challenged. Their superior class tells in the final furlong when rivals come under maximum pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider from midfield
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a complete lottery with multiple fallers or interference
scenarios.body: A horse like Zam Bobbler or Royal Soldier can benefit from the chaos ahead and emerge as a surprise winner. The race falls apart tactically and rewards those who stay out of trouble.

scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is truly savage and collapses dramatically
scenarios.body: Koktail Brut or Too Bossy For Us benefit from the carnage up front as their stamina reserves kick in. Their class shines through as the leaders tie up badly in the testing conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Oldschool Outlaw, How's Hannah, Highland Crystal, Charme De Faust, Future Prospect and Good Girl Kathleen will ensure a relentless gallop from the start in this Grade 1 contest. With six confirmed front-runners over 2m4f on yielding ground, the pace will be searingly strong throughout, creating a stamina examination that will find out the pretenders. The combination of the sustained gallop and testing conditions will set up a finish where horses with proven staying power can close from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those who can produce their best effort late, while the prominent runners with stamina will also benefit from the collapse of the early leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the six front-runners go too fast early and weaken dramatically from the second-last hurdle
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces, with proven stayers getting first run on tiring leaders. Late-running types with stamina reserves will have a significant tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Stayers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but sustainable, allowing prominent horses with stamina to kick clear
scenarios.body: The sustained but controlled gallop will suit horses who can race handily and have the engine to finish, avoiding both the early burn-out and the traffic problems. Those positioned in the first six but not leading will have the perfect tactical position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead while others battle behind
scenarios.body: Highland Crystal or How's Hannah could steal a march if they get a soft lead while the other pace-setters compromise each other. The winner would need to have enough in reserve to hold off the late charge from those given too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mullins Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If Willie Mullins' multiple runners create a race-winning tactical scenario through positioning
scenarios.body: With seven runners, Mullins can control the pace and positioning to set up his best chance perfectly for a late strike. The numerical advantage allows for tactical sacrifices to benefit the stable's main hope.

races.paceDynamic: Karamoja will lead from the flag with his confirmed front-running style, likely setting a sustainable gallop on the yielding to soft ground without early pressure from the prominent runners. The lack of other natural leaders means Jigoro, Break My Soul, Birdie Or Bust and Moudan will track in behind but won't force the pace early. This sets up a race where the tempo builds gradually, creating a searching gallop from the third-last fence that will test stamina reserves. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish with one sustained run rather than prominent runners who get drawn into a grinding battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Karamoja sets a steady pace that builds into a stamina test from three out
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up runners get the perfect setup to unleash one telling move, while the prominent horses get caught in no-man's land. Shuffle The Deck and Jalila Moriviere can time their challenges perfectly under expert pilots.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely searching throughout and tests the stamina of all hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of who can maintain their position closest to the pace without overexerting. Break My Soul and Jigoro have the class and tactical speed to kick clear when others weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Karamoja Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to organize a proper challenge
scenarios.body: Karamoja dictates terms throughout and has enough in reserve when the inevitable challenge comes up the straight. His recent Fairyhouse win shows he can handle this exact scenario when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Karamoja sets a crawling pace that produces a sprint finish unsuited to the distance
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of running style. This chaos scenario opens the door for unconsidered runners with residual ability.

races.paceDynamic: Sixmilebridge, Jacob's Ladder, Predators Gold and Pure Steel will ensure a relentless gallop from the start, with Sixmilebridge likely to grab the early lead given his front-running style and excellent soft ground record. This quartet of pace-setters will stretch the field out over the 2m4f trip, creating a true stamina test on yielding to soft conditions. The strong early pace will set up the race perfectly for hold-up horses with tactical speed who can pick off tired leaders. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up merchants who can stay the trip and have the class to capitalize when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners maintain a fierce gallop through the first two miles
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will drain the early leaders, allowing Western Fold and Jimmy Du Seuil to sweep past tired horses with their superior stamina reserves. Both have the class and tactical speed to capitalize when the gallop inevitably slows.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the perfect tracking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: Kappa Jy Pyke or Kala Conti can use their class advantage to strike at the optimal moment, having saved energy while staying within striking distance. Their prominent style allows them to avoid the worst of the early pace while remaining close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes more measured than expected due to tactical riding
scenarios.body: Jacob's Ladder or Sixmilebridge could steal a march on the field by dictating terms from the front without burning out. Their recent form suggests they have the stamina to sustain a controlled gallop over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners engage in a speed duel that destroys each other
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sitting duck for the most patient hold-up horse with the strongest finishing kick. Western Fold's closing style becomes devastating when the entire field comes back to him in the final half-mile.

races.paceDynamic: Final Demand, Kitzbuhel, Kaid d'Authie, Salvator Mundi, Predators Gold, Jacob's Ladder, Sixmilebridge, Downmexicoway and Pure Steel will ensure a relentless gallop from the start in this Grade 1 contest. The pace will be genuinely strong throughout the 2m4f trip on yielding to soft ground, with multiple Mullins runners happy to commit early. This demanding gallop will stretch the field and test stamina reserves to the maximum. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent runners with tactical speed - the pure front-runners face a gruelling task against this quality field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is truly relentless with multiple pace-setters going too fast
scenarios.body: The strong pace will collapse the front-runners in the final half-mile, allowing Western Fold and Oscars Brother to use their finishing kicks. Jimmy Du Seuil and Lovely Hurling can also benefit from the strong setup despite their lower ratings.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: These quality operators can track the leaders without doing the donkey work, then strike when the pace-setters weaken. Their class and tactical positioning proves decisive in a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners go suicidally fast and all tie up badly
scenarios.body: Even moderate finishers can pick up the pieces when the entire front division stops, creating chaos and opportunity. This becomes a lottery where any horse with stamina reserves can capitalise.

scenarios.title: Front-runner survives

scenarios.body: Kaid d'Authie or Final Demand could dictate sensible fractions while their main pace rivals compromise each other. The leader kicks clear when the chasers fail to respond effectively.

races.paceDynamic: Five Star Getaway will lead alone with no genuine pace pressure, creating a moderate gallop that builds gradually through the middle stages. The prominent brigade of City Chief, Big Interest, Solitary Man, Stuzzikini and Wrappedupinmay will cluster 3-4 lengths back, creating significant traffic congestion turning for home. Hold-up horses Hunters Yarn and Chemical Energy must navigate through this prominent pack while relying on a strong finishing kick. This controlled pace and prominent congestion clearly favours the front-runner and strong finishers who can stay wide - early leaders and patient hold-up horses benefit most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Five Star Getaway maintains his lead unchallenged through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The 12-year-old gets first run on the field and kicks clear 2 out, with the prominent pack stuck in traffic behind. Only wide-tracking finishers can mount a challenge but it's too late to peg back the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Clash
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners bunch up and engage in a scrimmage from 3 out
scenarios.body: This creates a war of attrition among City Chief, Big Interest, Solitary Man, Stuzzikini and Wrappedupinmay, allowing the strongest traveller to emerge. The moderate early pace leaves enough in reserve for a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Hunters Yarn and Chemical Energy find racing room wide or through gaps 2 out
scenarios.body: Both horses unleash their superior class and finishing speed to reel in a tiring leader and outpace the prominent pack. Their fresh legs and higher ratings prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Wrappedupinmay or Asphalt Cowboy avoid the prominent traffic and find a smooth passage
scenarios.body: One of the less fancied runners benefits from a trouble-free trip while the market leaders are compromised by pace or positioning. Their momentum carries them past faltering favourites.
